# aura-components-mcp (package v1.7.3; Session 2 working tree: 31 tools)

> Free-only MCP server (stdio, zero runtime dependencies, no login) for the Aura (aura.build) public catalogue. Node >=22. The checked-in package version remains 1.7.3; Session 2 changes are unreleased. Catalogue content belongs to Aura (Meng To / DesignCode).

- Repo: https://github.com/swastiksingh-dev/Aura-Components-MCP
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-components-mcp
- Setup: https://github.com/swastiksingh-dev/Aura-Components-MCP/blob/main/SETUP.md
- Tool contract catalogue: `docs/v2/TOOL_CONTRACTS.md`
- Session 2 context measurements: `docs/v2/CONTEXT_BASELINE_2026-11-23.md`
- Official Aura MCP (account projects/publishing, OAuth): https://www.aura.build/mcp

## Start here

- Call `aura_status`, then `aura_search_all` or the surface-specific search.
- Use `aura_prompt` for a user-customisable brief-to-prompt compatibility flow. It suggests Aura tools only and does not require a recipe or style.
- Discovery is metadata-first. Search defaults to five results; continue with `offset` / `next_offset`. Detail tools omit large source unless passed `chunk` or `full:true`.
- `aura_bundle` and `aura_scaffold_page` return metadata/source pointers by default. `aura_bundle` supports `full:true`; scaffold source is opt-in with `full:true`.
- `aura_diff` compares 2–4 free components using known record facts. Unavailable bundle size, runtime performance and visual quality are `unknown`.
- `aura_search_skills` reports `loadable` from available `name`/`description` frontmatter; `null` means the snippet was unavailable.
- Fresh docs (pure helpers; the agent calls Context7): `aura_docs_plan` and `aura_docs_check`.
- `aura_icon` returns an SVG and its required credit. `aura_version` checks npm; `aura_status` includes its verdict.
- Award intelligence: `aura_award_search`, `aura_award_inspect`, `aura_design_blueprint`, `aura_visual_audit`, `aura_motion_study`, `aura_award_index`. Browser capture is optional; unavailable evidence is reported honestly.

## Inspo bridge migration

The five external workflow-mapper tools `aura_inspo_recommend`,
`aura_inspo_components`, `aura_inspo_reference`, `aura_inspo_system`, and
`aura_inspo_compare` are removed from the Session 2 tool surface. Use Aura
catalogue searches for first-party options, award tools for reference evidence,
`aura_diff` for known-fact comparison, and `aura_scaffold_page` for an optional
caller-selected build plan. No current tool requires the external Inspo MCP.

## Rules and retrieval

- Component and asset access is fail-closed: only records with `premium:false` are returned by protected paths.
- No-match and upstream failure are distinct. Do not treat unavailable metrics as negative facts.
- Chunk responses expose length/truncation information. Fetch subsequent chunks with the same detail tool and the requested `chunk`.
- `slim:false` on component search is still bounded to 1,200 source characters per item and returns fetch pointers.
- Asset licensing: all-rights-reserved under Aura Terms §4; commercial reuse requires permission.
- Icon credit returned by `aura_icon` must be retained.
- Search is upstream-first. One-edit typo matching only ranks fetched candidates; it does not guarantee typo recall and makes no additional request.
- Preview screenshot caching is not implemented. Browser-backed features stay optional.
- Package release notes and the historical 35-tool v1.7.3 inventory are in README/CHANGELOG; they do not describe the unreleased Session 2 registry.
